description: This file declares utility functions related to configuration management in the Cuttlefish project, including functions for obtaining instance information, paths, and QEMU support checks.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the instance number derived from an environment variable or username.

methods.name: GetDefaultVsockCid
methods.description: Returns the default Vsock CID, calculated as GetInstance() + 2.

methods.name: GetVsockServerPort
methods.description: Calculates the Vsock server port number based on a base and guest CID.

methods.name: GetGlobalConfigFileLink
methods.description: Provides a path to a global config file link for easy discovery.

methods.name: ForCurrentInstance
methods.description: Modifies a prefix to make it unique per instance.

methods.name: InstanceFromString
methods.description: Parses an instance number from a string.

methods.name: RandomSerialNumber
methods.description: Generates a random serial number with a given prefix.

methods.name: DefaultHostArtifactsPath
methods.description: Returns the default path for host artifacts given a filename.

methods.name: DefaultQemuBinaryDir
methods.description: Returns the default directory for QEMU binaries.

methods.name: HostBinaryPath
methods.description: Returns the path to a host binary given a filename.

methods.name: HostUsrSharePath
methods.description: Returns the path to shared host resources.

methods.name: HostQemuBiosPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the QEMU BIOS.

methods.name: DefaultGuestImagePath
methods.description: Returns the default path for guest images.

methods.name: DefaultEnvironmentPath
methods.description: Returns a path based on environment key, default value, and base path.

methods.name: HostSupportsQemuCli
methods.description: Checks if the host supports QEMU command-line interface.

methods.name: UseQemuPrebuilt
methods.description: Indicates whether to use a prebuilt QEMU.

calls: std::string DefaultEnvironmentPath(const char* environment_key, const char* default_value, const char* path)
